decisions.reason: The schlager compilation is a released catalog item that sits close to the firm's established reissue business and fits its announced genre broadening, so holding it in a warehouse-backed catalog costs little and management is likely to keep stocking it rather than admit the genre move was a misstep.

The illustrated release series builds on the label's core strength in carefully produced editions and was publicly presented as a series with its own page, so commitment and sunk production effort favour continuing it and treating any weak early sales as a start-up effect.
